description: Update the existing auto-sell configuration with partial fields. Returns the updated `autoSettings` payload. Side effect: overwrites stored automation settings for the current user; not idempotent across different field sets. Requires a signature session and `mcp-session-id`. Use for INCREMENTAL changes after registration; read the baseline via `tronsave_get_user_auto_setting` to avoid accidental resets, and use `tronsave_register_auto_sell` only for first-time setup. Fails for invalid field combinations, unauthorized sessions, or policy constraints.

minAmount.description: Minimum TRX (sun semantics per API) for auto-stake trigger.

remainBalance.description: TRX balance floor to preserve after staking.

resourceStake.description: Whether auto-stake targets ENERGY or BANDWIDTH.

withdrawVote.description: GraphQL Float input for withdraw-vote configuration.

paymentMode.description: FIXED vs RANDOM payout mode when applicable.

paymentTimeWindow.description: Optional daily time window for scheduled payouts.

end.description: Window end as a non-negative GraphQL `Int` (same unit as `start`); end > start is enforced server-side, not by this schema.

start.description: Window start as a non-negative GraphQL `Int` (TronSave commonly uses minutes from midnight UTC, `0..1439`).

isAcceptExtended.description: Whether incoming extend-style matches are accepted.

maintainUnDelegate.description: Buffer of undelegated resource the seller keeps.

minPrice.description: Minimum unit price accepted for auto matches.

profitShare.description: Profit share percentage for this resource leg.
